verdict.rationale: Brex documents in-app travel booking, itinerary changes, and a read-only Travel API for viewing trips. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic monitoring of booked rates or rebooking when prices drop. Itinerary changes and trip viewing are adjacent features, not the requested capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
